A whole new generation is experiencing 9/11 – this time through internet memes. And thanks to AI and social media, what was once internet fodder hidden deep within emails and chat forums is now everywhere.

So how did this happen? Vox’s Today, Explained podcast explores why people joke about tragedies, and how that affects the way we process horrible events.
